description: This file defines platform-specific capabilities and configuration parameters for a motion sensor component in a hardware abstraction layer, including sensor capabilities, operational modes, timing, active monitoring windows, and notes.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns immutable capabilities of the motion sensor, such as sensor name, sensitivity range, and support for deep sleep autonomy.

methods.name: setActiveWindows
methods.description: Configures active monitoring windows during specified times of day.
